name: Bronze-featherback cake
summary: Bronze-featherback fish cake from Lak Lake, seasoned with only pepper and fish sauce and fried golden. It is crisp and naturally sweet.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 calls chả cá thát lát the taste people remember from Lak district.
howToEat: It comes to the plate with a few dill stems.
seoTitle: Cha ca that lat — fish cake at Lak Lake
seoDescription: Bronze-featherback fish cake from Lak Lake, fried golden with pepper and fish sauce, crisp and naturally sweet.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 calls the cake crisp and naturally sweet.
